name: LEXSA Student Food Pantry (Lismore)
summary: Free food, toiletries and sanitary items from the LEXSA office on SCU's Lismore campus.
key: Students can take 2 items from the pantry per day.
who: SCU students at the Lismore campus.
how: Ask staff at the LEXSA Office during opening hours.
catches: Free condoms, tampons and pads are also in the pantry.

evidence.quote: Students can take 2 items from the pantry per day.
